what.text: This page follows refugees from Pakistan living in Canada, as counted by UNHCR at the end of each year.
At the end of 2025, UNHCR counted 9044 Pakistani refugees in Canada, 10.0% of all refugees from Pakistan.
Afghanistan hosts the most Pakistani refugees, followed by the United Kingdom, Italy and Canada.

why.text: UCDP records armed conflict over the government of Pakistan with the MQM from 1994 to 1996 and from 2007 to 2025 with the TTP, Lashkar-e-Islam and IMU among the opponents.
It also records armed conflict over Balochistan territory in periods from 2004, most recently with the BRAS from 2019 to 2025.

when.text: UNHCR's series for this group starts in 1994 at 2721 refugees.
The figure was at its highest, 15820, at the end of 2007, and the main years of displacement in the data are 2003 to 2014 and 2025.

how.text: The sources don't say which routes people took or where they live in Canada.
These are year-end totals for Canada only, reported to UNHCR.
